relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that the anti-GFAP treatment increased expression of CGRP in SCI rats (Figure 3).

relationships.subject: Anti-GFAP antibody
relationships.evidence_quote: suggesting some pain hypersensitivity in the anti-GFAP treated rats

key_findings: Anti-GFAP antibody increased dorsal horn CGRP immunoreactivity in SCI rats compared with control IgG.
Anti-GFAP rats showed a trend toward increased pain sensitivity in the MCAP, without von Frey threshold changes.
